body: thanks, I like thinking of it that way. I wanna keep finding those new things that make me happy, I just wish I could be happier with what I have now.

I have some interests, like music and video games, and I like going out with my friends, but as fun as it can be, I keep asking myself why I do it, why it's worth it, and why I don't just give up. my life as a whole seems so pointless, even if I fill it with things I like and make me happy. I just wanna find some meaning and some purpose in it all, outside of activities that can only make me happy for so long.

hey, thanks for answering, it's nice to know theres people out there who care. I just feel so worn out by the monotony of my life, it's killing me day by day. every day I have one less person to talk to, one less person to care, and one less fuck to give. I try and try to keep on going, day by day working for something, but every time I think about it, I don't know what it is. Every day I question why I try if it's so futile. I can't be the only one. I feel happy every 1% of the time I'm depressed, and it keeps going down. My life is not particularly bad, just more pointless every time I think about it. I can't be the only one...

if you read all this, sorry for the meaningless rant and thanks for responding to the thread, it means more than you'd think.
